own. This file names every such component with its version, its licence as its package declares it
(an SPDX expression), the place its source code is offered, and its licence, copyright and NOTICE
texts in full, each once at the end. A bracketed mark like [0123abcd] leads to the text.

Components under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 are contained unmodified; their source code form is
available at the address named with each of them.

Where a package carries no licence file, nothing was made up: the standard text of every licence it
declares is named, with the placeholders of that standard text, and the authors its own manifest
names.

The Windows installers (.msi) were built with the WiX Toolset 5.0.2 (https://wixtoolset.org) and
contain its utility custom action library (Wix4UtilCA_X64) and its installer dialogs
(WixToolset.UI.wixext); the portable archives contain neither. They are the work of the WiX Toolset
contributors, under the licence that project declares for that version.

The container image also contains programs of the Debian project and of the Python Package Index.
They are not listed here: their licence texts are in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright and
/usr/share/doc/rdownloader/python/, and /usr/share/doc/rdownloader/SOURCES.txt says where their
source code is offered.

This file is generated (scripts/licenses.sh) and has not been reviewed by a lawyer.
